findings.operational_target_or_result_lookup: No path found in reviewed reachable functions that reads evaluator targets, scientific result logs, NSM catalog, seeds or prior answer files to decide a new entity response. This is a bounded static finding, not proof of absence in arbitrary code or binary internals.
findings.host_read_to_solution_write_callback: No such path found. Observations feed capture/render/storage, whereas inputs are explicit scenario properties, user requests or schedules frozen in geometry/curriculum.
findings.physical_preparation_and_sensors: Prepared native comparator rules, directions, guide clocks, guard geometry, phase windows and normalized format signals materially contribute. Experience supplies references/associations; those are not equivalent to acquiring the general comparator or schedule.
findings.manual_override: entrada deliberately exposes a named physical intervention. A user can inject arbitrary allowed payloads or choose an informative scenario; this interface is not a security sandbox or proof that every possible interactive session respects a blinded scientific protocol.
findings.dynamic_dispatch: Profile dispatch uses explicit profile/protocol strings; input dispatch uses getattr(world, kind) from an explicit user operation or the fixed submit/probe protocol. This is not output-conditioned routing. The static audit does not certify every arbitrary method-name input as a secure grammar; published event files use the declared methods.
findings.no_hidden_secondary_runtime: Factories prepare recipe components before creating one OrganizationalWorld; wrappers attach the same world. Static review does not claim all higher-level organizations are one fused individual merely because they share Runtime.
findings.scientific_scope: Information-boundary review supports provenance separation only. It does not establish semantic mastery, causal efficacy of every output, advantage, general intelligence, or all microscopic correctness.
